name: Dew-dried grass duck
nameVi: Vịt cỏ phơi sương om mắc mật
summary: Vịt cỏ phơi sương om mắc mật is a grass duck dried in the dew, then stewed with mắc mật leaf, a different plate from the roast duck.
howToEat: Order it on the eastern route when you want the duck stewed rather than roasted.
